data.desc: Aptevo Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq:APVO) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing novel multispecific immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer. The Company's pipeline candidates are created from its proprietary ADAPTIR and ADAPTIR-FLEX platform technologies and are designed to engage the immune system through differentiated mechanisms of action. Aptevo's mission is to improve treatment outcomes and transform the lives of cancer patients.
